judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a `.lore/dod.md` planning file, an acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), and an update to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, without implementing any production code in `src/` (`messages.ts`, `validation.ts`, `messageHandler.ts`, `createServer.ts`, `config.ts`, etc.). As a result, all the new acceptance tests fail immediately and `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` does not exist. Furthermore, the candidate's plan and tests violate explicit requirements in the issue: it gates the feature on `transport.resume.enabled` instead of the required separate `transport.history.enabled` flag, and it expects `limit: 0` to be valid instead of rejecting limits outside 1–200. Required updates to `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/getting-started.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md` are also completely missing.
